info.name: Ardh Property Management API (Cookie Auth)
info.description:
Postman Collection for the ARDH Property Management Backend API.

## Authentication
Auth relies strictly on HTTP-only cookies — no Bearer tokens. Run '1. Sign In (Login)' first; the response sets the session cookie, which Postman stores in its cookie jar and sends automatically on every subsequent request. '7. Logout' clears it.

Seeded users (SEED_MODE=reset on startup):
  admin@admin.com / P@ssw0rd (full access)
  manager@gmail.com / P@ssw0rd (property_manager: dashboard, vendors, equipment, amc_contracts, maintenance, expenses, occupancy_reports)
  accountant@gmail.com / P@ssw0rd (accountant: dashboard, income, reports, expenses)

## Setup
Set the collection variable baseUrl to your API origin, e.g. http://localhost:5240 (no trailing slash). Example IDs throughout the collection match the seeded demo data, so requests work out of the box on a freshly seeded database.

## Delete endpoints
Soft-delete endpoints require the system admin password, passed as the password query parameter (or the X-Admin-Password header). The default value is 'adminpassword' — change it to whatever AdminSettings.Password is configured to.

## Permission model
Permissions are granular per module now (not the old 5 buckets): dashboard, buildings, owners, apartments, tenants, vendors, equipment, amc_contracts, maintenance, income, reports, expenses, occupancy_reports, admin. A role's Permissions field is resolved as (role defaults) UNION (whatever extra modules were explicitly granted) - it can only add on top of the role's defaults, never remove from them.

Role defaults: admin -> all 14; viewer -> none (an admin must explicitly grant each module); property_manager -> dashboard, vendors, equipment, amc_contracts, maintenance, expenses, occupancy_reports; accountant -> dashboard, income, reports, expenses.

Route -> required module: /api/buildings -> buildings; /api/owners -> owners; /api/apartments -> apartments; /api/tenants -> tenants; /api/vendors -> vendors; /api/equipment -> equipment; /api/amc-contracts -> amc_contracts; /api/maintenance -> maintenance; /api/income -> income; /api/reports -> reports; /api/expenses -> expenses; /api/dashboard + /api/activities -> dashboard; /api/users + /api/settings + /api/deleted-history -> admin (unsplit). /api/notifications and /api/upload are open to any authenticated user regardless of permission.

GET on the 11 resource modules (buildings through expenses) is open-read for any authenticated user - only mutating verbs (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) require the specific module permission. There is no role-based bypass for property_manager or any other non-admin role; access is driven strictly by the resolved Permissions claim. viewer additionally can never call a mutating verb on anything, regardless of granted modules.

## Bulk upload
Bulk upload is fully asynchronous: (1) BU-00 upload the XLSX -> returns a URL, (2) BU-XX-01 start the job with module + fileUrl -> returns the job id instantly, (3) poll BU-XX-03 status until Finished/Failed, (4) download the processed XLSX (each row carries status/error columns). If the server restarts mid-job, the job is automatically recovered on startup.

Download endpoints (O-06, AP-06, T-06, E-07, M-09, I-08, EX-07, R-04) return XLSX workbooks; I-07 returns a PDF receipt.

query.description: Export report type: combined, income, or expense (defaults to combined)

request.description:
Exports a report as an XLSX workbook. type is required and validated.

Valid type values (exact):
  income   - all filtered income records (same columns as I-08)
  expenses - all filtered expense records (same columns as EX-07) — 'expense' also accepted
  combined - dated transaction ledger merging income + expense into one feed (default)

Any other type returns 400. Optional filters: buildingId, startDate, endDate.
Returns an .xlsx file (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet).

response.name: Success Example (200 - XLSX report)
response.body:
Binary XLSX file. Income/expense/combined report — download and open in Excel.
Income export rows: Date, Type, Category, Description, Amount, Status, BuildingName, FlatNumber.

response.name: Error Example (400 - Invalid type)

query.description: Required. Report window end date (YYYY-MM-DD). Clamped to today if it lies in the future - the report never calculates future occupancy.
Optional building UUID filter. If omitted, reports across all buildings.
Number of items per page (defaults to 10)

request.description: Per-apartment occupancy report for a date range: occupied/vacant days (and calendar-accurate month/day display), plus rent figures using the rent that actually applied during each historical period - not today's rent. If a rent change happened mid-lease it is split into the correct sub-periods automatically. Vacant gaps between two known leases are valued at the preceding lease's rate; open-ended/never-let vacancy is valued at the apartment's current ExpectedRent. toDate is clamped to today; a fromDate after today returns 400.

request.description:

Valid enum values (exact):
  priority = Low | Medium | High | Critical

When recurrenceFrequency is set, startDate is required. nextMaintenanceDate is computed from the last completion date (or startDate if never completed) using real calendar months/years - e.g. Monthly = +1 calendar month - not a flat day count.

request.description:
Creates a new expense record.
Mandatory fields: expenseHead, specificItem, nature, amount, entity, buildingId, expenseDate, paymentMethod and status.
For ApartmentSpecific entity, apartmentId is also mandatory.
Enum values must use the exact spellings below (single words, no spaces, no dashes):
category = Utility | Operational | Maintenance | Tax | Capital (optional)
nature = Service | Material | Others
entity = General | ApartmentSpecific | BuildingLevel
status = Draft | PendingPayment | Paid
paymentMethod is free-form text - any value works, for example: Cash, BankTransfer, Cheque, UPI, Card, Online.
Rules:
- Amount must be greater than 0.
- Expense date cannot be in the future (today or earlier).
- A duplicate entry (same amount + expense date + expense head + specific item + nature) is rejected.
- When specificItem is "Water Tanker" (case-insensitive), tankerNumber, timeOfDelivery, deliveryDriverName, managerInAttendance
  and litersFilled become required, and the same tanker number at the same delivery time is rejected.
- timeOfDelivery accepts either a bare time (e.g. "13:31", "01:31 PM" - combined with expenseDate) or a full ISO date-time.

{
    "category": "Utility", // [optional] Exact values: Utility | Operational | Maintenance | Tax | Capital
    "expenseHead": "Water Tank Supply", // [REQUIRED] Expense head (e.g. Electricity Bill, Water Tank Supply, Housekeeping)
    "specificItem": "Water Tanker", // [REQUIRED] Set to "Water Tanker" (case-insensitive) to require the tankerNumber/timeOfDelivery/deliveryDriverName/managerInAttendance/litersFilled fields below
    "vendorId": "f7c7b822-29c4-52a8-ad29-c8be5d491f41", // [optional] Vendor UUID
    "nature": "Service", // [REQUIRED] Exact values: Service | Material | Others

    "expenseDate": "2026-08-05T00:00:00Z", // [REQUIRED] Expense date - must be today or earlier (not in the future)
    "paymentMethod": "Cash", // [REQUIRED] Free text: Cash, BankTransfer, Cheque, UPI, Card, Online, ...
    "status": "Paid", // [REQUIRED] Exact values: Draft | PendingPayment | Paid

Mandatory fields: id, expenseHead, specificItem, nature, amount, entity, buildingId, expenseDate, paymentMethod and status.
For ApartmentSpecific entity, apartmentId is also mandatory.
Enum values must use the exact spellings below (single words, no spaces, no dashes):
category = Utility | Operational | Maintenance | Tax | Capital (optional)
nature = Service | Material | Others
entity = General | ApartmentSpecific | BuildingLevel
status = Draft | PendingPayment | Paid
paymentMethod is free-form text - any value works, for example: Cash, BankTransfer, Cheque, UPI, Card, Online.
Rules:
- Amount must be greater than 0.
- Expense date cannot be in the future (today or earlier).
- A duplicate entry (same amount + expense date + expense head + specific item + nature) is rejected.
- When specificItem is "Water Tanker" (case-insensitive), tankerNumber, timeOfDelivery, deliveryDriverName, managerInAttendance
  and litersFilled become required, and the same tanker number at the same delivery time is rejected.
- timeOfDelivery accepts either a bare time (e.g. "13:31", "01:31 PM" - combined with expenseDate) or a full ISO date-time.

body.raw:
{
    "id": "e4c7b822-29c4-52a8-ad29-c8be5d491f42", // [REQUIRED] Expense record UUID
    "category": "Utility", // [optional] Exact values: Utility | Operational | Maintenance | Tax | Capital
    "expenseHead": "Water Tank Supply", // [REQUIRED] Expense head (e.g. Electricity Bill, Water Tank Supply, Housekeeping)
    "specificItem": "Water Tanker", // [REQUIRED] Set to "Water Tanker" (case-insensitive) to trigger the tanker fields below
    "vendorId": "f7c7b822-29c4-52a8-ad29-c8be5d491f41", // [optional] Vendor UUID
    "nature": "Service", // [REQUIRED] Exact values: Service | Material | Others
    "amount": 900.00, // [REQUIRED] Amount must be greater than 0
    "entity": "BuildingLevel", // [REQUIRED] Exact values: General | ApartmentSpecific | BuildingLevel
    "buildingId": "b1f7b822-29c4-52a8-ad29-c8be5d491f24", // [REQUIRED] Building UUID
    "expenseDate": "2026-08-05T00:00:00Z", // [REQUIRED] Expense date - must be today or earlier (not in the future)
    "paymentMethod": "Cash", // [REQUIRED] Free text: Cash, BankTransfer, Cheque, UPI, Card, Online, ...
    "status": "Paid", // [REQUIRED] Exact values: Draft | PendingPayment | Paid
    "tankerNumber": "KA-09-1234", // [REQUIRED for water tank] Tanker vehicle / challan number
    "timeOfDelivery": "2026-08-05T09:30:00Z", // [REQUIRED for water tank] Bare time (e.g. "13:31", combined with expenseDate) or full ISO date-time
    "deliveryDriverName": "Ramesh", // [REQUIRED for water tank] Driver name
    "managerInAttendance": "Arun Roy", // [REQUIRED for water tank] Manager who received the delivery
    "litersFilled": 13000, // [REQUIRED for water tank] Quantity in liters, must be greater than 0
    "description": "Monthly water tanker for Grand Plaza Towers - liters corrected after redelivery." // [optional] Internal description
}
